papers.title: An intertwined neural network model for EEG classification in brain-computer interfaces
papers.abstract: Presents a deep neural network architecture engineered to provide state-of-the-art performance in motor imagery classification while remaining robust to preprocessing. Based on intertwined time-distributed fully connected (tdFC) and space-distributed 1D temporal convolutional layers (sdConv), explicitly modeling spatial-temporal interactions across all levels of feature hierarchy.

papers.title: Transfer Learning for Brain-Computer Interfaces: A Euclidean Space Data Alignment Approach
papers.abstract: EEG signals suffer from significant inter-subject and inter-session variability. This paper proposes Euclidean space data alignment (EA) to reduce domain shift by aligning covariance matrices before feature extraction or Riemannian classification.
papers.primary_model: Euclidean Alignment + Tangent Space Logistic Regression

papers.title: EEGNet: A Compact Convolutional Neural Network for EEG-based Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Proposes EEGNet, an architecture using depthwise separable convolutions that encapsulates frequency filtering and spatial filtering in a lightweight parameter footprint (< 3,000 parameters).
